# uptimekuma_monitor_pm2 (Data Source)

Get PM2 monitor information by ID or name

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Read PM2 monitor by name
data "uptimekuma_monitor_pm2" "example" {
  name = "API Server"
}

# Example: Read PM2 monitor by ID
data "uptimekuma_monitor_pm2" "by_id" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier
- `name` (String) Monitor name

### Read-Only

- `process_name` (String) PM2 process name or numeric PM2 id being checked, as stored by Uptime Kuma and therefore without surrounding whitespace
